heading: INT. ORBITAL STATION HELIOS-9 - HYDROPONIC GARDEN - SHIP'S NIGHT

units.text: INT. ORBITAL STATION HELIOS-9 - HYDROPONIC GARDEN - SHIP'S NIGHT
Terraced racks of green, glowing under violet lamps.
Water mists from ceiling nozzles.
A pale artificial dawn climbs the curved bulkhead.
CAPTAIN ISADORA QUELLE (50s, silver crop, grey uniform) inspects a tomato vine.
ENGINEER BORIS NAKASHIMA-WEBB (40s, grease-stained overalls) crouches at a pump.
DR. PILAR ONDIEKI (30s, white coat) logs soil samples.
ZEPHYR ADEBAYO-LANG (20s, cadet, tablet in hand) trails the captain.
OTIENO RIVERA (30s, botanist, gloves, pruning shears) prunes basil.
A hatch in the far wall hisses open.
An INTRUDER (unknown, tall, hooded in a gray ship-issue jacket, face in shadow) steps through and stands at the threshold.
Cadet, who is that?
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: I... don't have a log of anyone in this sector.
units.name: ZEPHYR

units.text: Sir. Identify yourself.
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: The INTRUDER lowers the hood.
A woman, 30s, hollow-eyed, her hair shorn, her skin faintly translucent.
Kora. Third crew rotation.
units.name: INTRUDER

units.text: There was no third rotation.
units.name: PILAR

units.text: There was. You deleted it.
units.name: KORA

units.text: Boris rises slowly, a wrench in his hand.
Otieno steps back, shears raised like a tiny sword.
I only came for the seeds.
units.name: KORA

units.text: What seeds?
units.name: ISADORA

units.text: The ones you brought from the surface. The ones that remember.
units.name: KORA

units.text: The lamps overhead stutter.
Zephyr drops the tablet.
It clatters.

Everyone freezes, and then, together, the group bolts toward the main hatch, Boris dragging Pilar, Otieno shoving Zephyr ahead, Isadora at the rear with her hand on the door lever, while Kora stands among the rows, watching them go, smiling.
They always run to the same door.
units.name: KORA
